body.name: \(\mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY,pub}}\)
body.construction:
Define the published Choi--Yuan model-and-scalar-functional class by
\[
 \mathfrak M^{\mathrm{CY,pub}}
 =\{(P_n)_{n\ge1}:\mathsf A_{\mathrm{pub,dec}}((P_n))
 \wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{pub,rank}}((P_n))
 \wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{pub,inc}}((P_n))
 \wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{pub,cond}}((P_n))
 \wedge\mathsf A_{\mathrm{pub,noise}}((P_n))
 \wedge\bigwedge_{j=1}^6\mathsf A_{\mathrm{pub},j}((P_n))\}.
\]
The displayed predicates are the approximate-rank decomposition, leading-rank restriction, global singular-vector incoherence and conditioning, i.i.d. homoskedastic sub-Gaussian noise, and six scalar-functional conditions stated in the corresponding member-property nodes.
